weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，向你周圍的人擴大信任是很重要的。避免匆忙作出決定；相反，請花點時間反思。今天，你的情緒意識得到了提高，這有助於澄清你思想中的任何困惑。你的同理心達到前所未有的高度，這讓你對他人特別有吸引力，尤其是在夜幕降臨之際。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, it's important to extend trust to those around you. Avoid rushing into decisions; instead, take a moment to reflect. Today, your emotional awareness is heightened, which can help clarify any confusion in your thoughts. Your empathy is at an all-time high, making you particularly appealing to others, especially as the evening unfolds.

taurus.horoscope: 今天，金牛座，是時候拋開你的實際一面，調整你的情緒了。雖然你可能會傾向於保護自己的感受，但請記住，與他人分享這些感受可以帶來更深入的理解。深入挖掘，發掘你真正相信自己感受的核心。你今天的頭腦敏銳而清晰，所以充分利用它吧！
taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, it's time to set aside your practical side and tune into your emotions. While you might feel inclined to guard your feelings, remember that sharing them with others can lead to deeper understanding. Dig deep to uncover what you truly believe lies at the core of your feelings. Your mind is sharp and clear today, so make the most of it!

gemini.horoscope: 今天就聯絡你的朋友，雙子座。你可能會發現自己的想法有點停滯不前，與他人聯繫可能是提振精神的完美方式。請記得慢慢來，並向周圍的人展現耐心，因為緊張情緒可能會越來越高。在處理更深層次的情緒時要小心，確保你做好準備並保持安全。
gemini.horoscope_en: Reach out to a friend today, Gemini. You might find your thoughts feeling a bit stagnant, and connecting with others could be the perfect way to lift your spirits. Remember to take things slowly and extend patience to those around you, as tensions may be running high. Be cautious as you navigate deeper emotions—ensure you're prepared and safe.

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，今天對你來說是一個順暢航行的日子，所以請充分利用來臨的光明時刻。你的直覺得到增強，讓你輕鬆感受到周圍人的情緒。你的關懷本性受到追捧，因為其他人會尋找富有同情心的耳朵。請記得優先考慮自己的健康，並為自己保留一些能量。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today is a day of smooth sailing for you, Cancer, so take advantage of the bright moments that come your way. Your intuition is heightened, allowing you to easily sense the emotions of those around you. Your caring nature is sought after, as others will be looking for a compassionate ear. Just remember to prioritize your own well-being and reserve some energy for yourself.

leo.horoscope: 今天，獅子座，你可能會發現自己對周圍人的不確定性感到憤怒。請記住，儘管他們猶豫不決，你仍然有能力向前邁進。沒有必要在等待他人決定時猶豫不決；採取主動，追求自己的道路。相信其他人做好準備後會跟隨。您的主要重點應該放在自己的旅程上，而不是管理他人的感受。
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you might find yourself feeling exasperated by the uncertainty of those around you. Remember, you have the power to move forward despite their hesitation. There's no need to hold back while waiting for others to decide; take the initiative and pursue your own path. Trust that others will follow when they are prepared. Your primary focus should be on your own journey, not on managing the feelings of others.

virgo.horoscope: 今天，處女座，你可能會發現與特別的人分享你的感受非常簡單。如果有一個想法壓在你的心上，抓住這個時刻表達出來。您將能夠清晰有效地表達您的情緒。有把握地說出你的真相，以避免顯得有需要或不安全。請記住，您的敏感性是您周圍的人會注意到並珍惜的寶貴特質。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today, Virgo, you might find it surprisingly simple to share your feelings with someone special. If there's been a thought weighing on your heart, seize this moment to voice it. You'll have the ability to articulate your emotions clearly and effectively. Speak your truth with assurance to avoid appearing needy or insecure. Remember, your sensitivity is a valuable trait that those around you will notice and cherish.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，你是否感覺到有一點陰鬱徘徊在你的一天？這是可以理解的。你可能會覺得自己在厚厚的泥漿中跋涉，所以穿上靴子，正面應對挑戰。這是你可以採取的最佳方法。其他人可能更煩躁，反應更快，即使對輕鬆的評論也是如此。避免嘗試破譯你周圍令人困惑的情況；在幾天內，當清晰度恢復時，重新審視它們。
libra.horoscope_en: Are you sensing a bit of gloom hovering over your day, Libra? It’s understandable. You might feel as if you’re wading through thick mud, so put on your boots and tackle the challenges head-on. That’s the best approach you can take. Others may be more irritable and quick to react, even to light-hearted comments. Avoid trying to decipher the puzzling situations around you right now; revisit them in a few days when clarity returns.

scorpio.horoscope: 今天，天蠍座，你的直覺比以往任何時候都更敏銳，你的注意力集中在身上。雖然其他人可能會遇到困難，但你作為支持的燈塔而脫穎而出。你出色的思維清晰度將在今天為你提供良好的服務。您可以輕鬆地表達自己的情緒，並且可能會發現其他人比平時更願意接受您的想法。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, your intuition is sharper than ever, and your focus is spot on. While others may struggle, you stand out as a beacon of support. Your remarkable clarity of thought will serve you well today. You'll express your emotions with ease, and you'll likely find that others are more open to your ideas than they typically are.

sagittarius.horoscope: 今天，射手座，你可能會感覺到一種更沉重的氣氛，與你充滿活力的精神不太相符。你周圍的嚴肅情緒是怎麼回事？無論您是否發現原因，請記住，這可能不是您行為的反映。看來被壓抑的感覺已經準備好爆發，就像火山釋放其積聚的巖漿一樣。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today, Sagittarius, you may sense a heavier atmosphere that doesn't quite sit well with your vibrant spirit. What’s with all the seriousness around you? Regardless of whether you uncover the reason, remember that it’s likely not a reflection of your actions. It seems that pent-up feelings are ready to erupt, similar to a volcano releasing its built-up magma.

capricorn.horoscope: 當然，摩羯座，去享受那多餘的餅乾吧！毫無愧疚地品嚐美食，沒必要這樣做。今天的重點是釋放任何後悔的感覺。分享你的感受，但不要徘徊在上面。你的情緒意識提高了，所以記得要保護你的能量。你可能會感覺到周圍人的強烈氛圍，所以要小心行事。 展現你的同情心，但不要背負他們的負擔；他們有責任處理自己的問題。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Absolutely, Capricorn, go ahead and indulge in that extra cookie! Savor it without any guilt—there's no need for that. Today is all about releasing any feelings of regret. Share your feelings, but try not to linger on them. Your emotional awareness is heightened, so remember to protect your energy. You may sense the strong vibes from those around you, so tread carefully. Offer your compassion, but don’t carry their burdens; it's their responsibility to handle their own issues.

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，今天可能是那些沙發叫你名字的日子之一。欣然接受！如果您今晚想在家裡放鬆身心，不必匆忙出門拍一部精彩的電影。當朋友拜訪你時，請誠實說出你的感受。他們可以感覺到到底發生了什麼，所以沒有必要裝飾立面。這是表達真實情感的完美日子。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Aquarius, today might be one of those days where the couch calls your name. Embrace it! There's no need to rush out if you'd rather relax at home with a great film this evening. When friends check in on you, be truthful about your feelings. They can sense what's really going on, so there's no point in putting on a facade. This is a perfect day to express your true emotions.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，宇宙終於與你的觀點一致了。擁抱真實的自我，不要猶豫，坦率地表達你的想法。你的思路清晰而集中。運用你富有洞察力的智慧來應對任何心理挑戰。你充滿激情的精神擁有巨大的力量，因此請仔細選擇你的行動。今天可能是一個轉捩點，讓其他人明白你並不像他們曾經認為的那樣非傳統。
pisces.horoscope_en: At last, the universe is aligning with your perspective, Pisces. Embrace your true self and don’t hesitate to express your thoughts candidly. Your clarity of thought is sharp and concentrated. Harness your insightful intellect to tackle any mental challenges. Your passionate spirit holds great strength, so choose your actions thoughtfully. Today could be a turning point where others come to understand that you’re not as unconventional as they once believed.
